summary: The comment argues that cutting the E‑Rate program would negatively affect many school districts and libraries.

claims.argument: Eliminating E‑Rate would reduce essential funding for schools and libraries, harming their ability to provide affordable internet access.
claims.evidence_quote: ls nationwide. Over the past four years, E-Rate has provided more than $471 million in assistance to Illinois schools and libraries. Cutting this program will impact many districts and libraries.
